messages:
Anna (Design): quick q — small multiples: should we default to shared y-axis or independent per-panel? i mocked both.
Miguel (Eng-Frontend): shared is easiest for cross-panel comparisons. independent surfaces small spikes.
Liam (DataViz): agree w/ miguel. shared helps compare magnitudes; independent helps signal detection. maybe a user toggle?
Sara (PM): toggle makes sense. what should be the default for new users? shared probably less surprising.
Anna (Design): thinking default = shared. UI: a compact pill `Scale: Shared | Independent` in the top-right of the grid. tooltip explains tradeoffs.
Miguel (Eng-Frontend): UX/accessibility nit: pill needs to be keyboard focusable + have aria-labels. also visible focus ring for keyboard nav.
Liam (DataViz): also smoothing interactions: if user toggles smoothing globally, does it apply per-panel? my vote: apply per-series and reflect in legend.
Anna (Design): legend idea: show label, swatch, unit, and a small `smoothed` micro-chip when smoothing is active for that series.
Sara (PM): outliers — we shouldn't auto-rescale whole panel because a single spike ruins comparability. proposal: soft-clamp at 99th pct with an overflow marker on point.
Anna (Design): sketch (ascii):
```
[ small-multiples grid ]
(legend) (Scale pill) (time range)
panel: series lines, clipped points show a chevron ^ overlay
```
Miguel (Eng-Frontend): implementation note: clipping badge requires per-series outlier counts. we can add `outlier_count` to `/api/series-metrics` response.
Liam (DataViz): accessibility: legends must be operable by keyboard (Enter toggles visibility). include `aria-pressed` and an announcement like "Series X hidden" via polite aria-live.
DesignBot: heads-up: open ticket #423 is about legend keyboard focus, linking here.
Anna (Design): copy for tooltip: "Scale panels by: Shared across panels — keeps y-axis consistent for easy comparison. Independent per panel — emphasizes local trends." badge text: "clipped".
Sara (PM): plan: ship UI pill + legend chips + clip marker in next sprint. a11y improvements tracked in follow-up tickets.
Miguel (Eng-Frontend): i'll stub the API changes and add a small feature flag.
Liam (DataViz): i'll prototype perf & clarity differences (2 versions) and post screenshots.
Anna (Design): thanks! i'll update the mock and add states. :tada:
